blocking_findings.detail: scripts/train_tracelet_cnof_gate.py::_build_scaled_manifest_sampler hardcodes positional layers denovo/corruption/mmp with n_corruption=len(corruption)+len(cycle); cycle ops are inside 'corruption' and cannot be weighted independently.
blocking_findings.title: sampler has no independent cycle_ops layer

blocking_findings.detail: analogue_prior.build_analogue_prior_records reads the pool in FILE ORDER with a count cap and applies NO partition filter. Pool split_seed=20260714 (random 400k) != ringcore-v1 scaffold partition, so MMP training records can share scaffolds with the new validation/test partitions.
blocking_findings.requires: owner decision: re-partition the pool under the ringcore-v1 scaffold key, or exclude MMP
blocking_findings.title: MMP pool bypasses the scaffold partition

blocking_findings.detail: the gate still rebuilds corruption in-memory via build_corrupted_prior_records(edit_smiles,...); nothing reads edit_precompile_v1. Stage 2 loader is required before the precompiled corpus can be trained on.
blocking_findings.title: trainer does not read the precompiled shards
